SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT IVDT.BUYER,IVDT.INV_NO,IVDT.INV_SEQ,IVHD.INV_TYPE AS PROCESS_TYPE, IVDT.STATUS FROM ICOMIVHD IVHD, ICOMIVDT IVDT WHERE IVDT.SND_CHK = 'N' AND IVDT.BUYER = 'KRSSAN0025' AND IVDT.BUYER = IVHD.BUYER AND IVDT.INV_NO= IVHD.INV_NO AND IVHD.INV_TYPE = '0' AND trim(IVHD.LEGACY_IV_SERIAL) IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT IVDT.BUYER,IVDT.INV_NO,IVDT.INV_SEQ,IVHD.INV_TYPE AS PROCESS_TYPE, IVDT.STATUS FROM ICOMIVHD IVHD, ICOMIVDT IVDT WHERE IVDT.SND_CHK in ('Y','N') AND IVDT.BUYER = 'KRSSAN0025' AND IVDT.BUYER = IVHD.BUYER AND IVDT.INV_NO= IVHD.INV_NO AND IVHD.INV_TYPE = '0' AND trim(IVHD.LEGACY_IV_SERIAL) IS NOT NULL AND IVDT.STATUS = 'D' UNION SELECT BUYER,INV_NO,INV_SEQ,PROCESS_TYPE, STATUS FROM WMSIVDT WHERE SND_CHK = 'N' AND BUYER = 'KRSSAN0025' AND trim(LEGACY_IV_SERIAL) IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT BUYER,INV_NO,INV_SEQ,PROCESS_TYPE, STATUS FROM WMSIVDT WHERE SND_CHK IN ('Y','N') AND BUYER = 'KRSSAN0025' AND trim(LEGACY_IV_SERIAL) IS NOT NULL AND STATUS = 'D'
